# DecorationStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Line style for text decorations (underline/strikethrough/overline). All variants are painted with straight `DrawLine` segments so they render identically on the PDF and SVG canvases.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Solid`: A single continuous line (default).
- `Wavy`: A sine wave, e.g. a spell-check squiggle.
- `Dashed`: Evenly spaced dashes.
- `Dotted`: Evenly spaced dots.
